title: GET /api/v1/users/:username/heartbeats/spans, 200
description: StatsController#user_spans (stats_controller.rb lines 115-126) returns Heartbeat.to_span (heartbeatable.rb lines 86-134) over every category, in one order across the selected projects, with the 120 s timeout. A span ends at a heartbeat whose next gap is over 120 s and gets min(gap, 120) added as its tail. The last span gets no tail. A span whose duration is 0, a lone heartbeat, is dropped.

start_time.description: Epoch seconds of the span's first heartbeat.

end_time.description: The last heartbeat's time plus the tail, in epoch seconds.

duration.description: Always over 0. The span's last heartbeat minus its first, rounded to whole seconds, plus the tail, which isn't rounded. So it can have a fraction.
